programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes conocen a una chica que cuida a un grupo de Xatu con poderes psíquicos que predicen el futuro de una aldea. Cuando los aldeanos comienzan a dudar de ellos, ¿podrán los Xatu probar la verdad de sus visiones?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Al llegar al Lago Furia, Pikachu y Togepi enferman, y nuestros héroes son atacados por un Gyarados rojo enfurecido. Cuando el Equipo Rocket aparece en escena, las cosas parecen mucho más peligrosas para Ash y sus amigos…

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Las cosas se ven mal para nuestros héroes, quienes han sido capturados por el Equipo Rocket en el Lago Furia. Con el destino de los Pokémon del mundo en juego, ¿podrá Ash sobreponerse a la ocasión y salvar el día?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Después de llegar a Pueblo Mahogany, Ash entrena para su próxima batalla de gimnasio. Pero tras ser despreciado por Pryce, el líder de gimnasio, ¿podrá nuestro héroe convencer a su gélido oponente de darle una oportunidad?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Pryce y Ash están a punto de enfrentarse en un frío concurso en el gimnasio del pueblo Mahogany. ¿Podrá Ash mostrar lo que sus Pokémon y él pueden hacer y así ganar su séptima medalla de gimnasio de la región Johto?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes encuentran grupos de batalla de Bellossom y Vileplume, recientemente evolucionados. Como cada grupo lucha cada vez con mayor número e intensidad, ¿podrán nuestros héroes ponerle fin a la disputa?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.sub-title: A algunos les gusta el calor
programme.desc: ¡El calor se eleva en el viaje de nuestros héroes cuando Misty y sus Pokémon tipo Agua se enfrentan de lleno a un terco Entrenador tipo Fuego!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Ash y amigos se encuentran con una maga Pokémon, y pronto salen a buscar los ingredientes para su más grande hechizo hasta ahora.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Tras otro encuentro con el Equipo Rocket, Pikachu queda exhausto y débil. Por suerte, un transeúnte lleva a nuestros héroes a un lago cercano que ayuda a recargar a los tipo Eléctrico... ¡y que también oculta un gran secreto!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.sub-title: El mismo baile y la vieja canción
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes toman tiempo para disfrutar el entretenimiento del acto de un joven Entrenador y su Igglybuff. Pero no pasa mucho tiempo antes de que el Equipo Rocket llegue y trate de robarse el espectáculo.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Un viaje fortuito a un templo de SlowPoké le da a nuestros héroes la oportunidad de buscar conocimiento… ¡y le da al Equipo Rocket la oportunidad de aligerar algunos bolsillos!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.sub-title: Que el verdadero profesor Oak se ponga de pie
programme.desc: Un evento de celebridades inspira a Jessie y a James a fingir ser importantes y así llenar sus hambrientos estómagos. Al poco tiempo, sus disfraces son puestos a prueba por el verdadero invitado de honor: ¡El Profesor Oak!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.sub-title: Un deseo con forma de estrella
programme.desc: Cuando nuestros héroes ven un objeto cayendo del cielo nocturno, corren a investigar. Pronto, unen fuerzas con un club de misterio Pokémon para descubrir los secretos revelados por el Cleffa caído y las estrellas del cielo.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Ash y Misty discuten sobre quién puede derrotar a un poderoso Entrenador y a su Poliwrath. Cuando él acepta ambos retos, la dura batalla que sigue le da a Misty algunas ideas sobre su propio Poliwhirl.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Tras oír sobre un parque de batallas cercano, Ash está ansioso por probar sus habilidades. Pero el trío del Equipo Rocket recientemente se unió al parque, y tienen algunas ideas para probar el temple de este Entrenador.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Es un caso de identidad errónea para el Politoed de Misty cuando lo obligan a reemplaza al líder de un equipo de Porristas Pokémon... Pero, ¿adónde se fue el otro Politoed?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: En las afueras de Ciudad Espina Negra, Ash conoce a la Líder de Gimnasio Clair, quien entrena a su Dratini para una ceremonia. Pero el Equipo Rocket tiene otros planes para el tipo Dragón, y Ash y Clair deben detenerlos.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Al enfrentarse a Clair, Líder del Gimnasio Espina Negra, Ash tiene dificultades para vencer a su Pokémon tipo Dragón. Todo se complica cuando el Equipo Rocket intenta robar la reliquia de Colmillo de Dragón de la ciudad.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: El Equipo Rocket ha tomado el Colmillo de Dragón de Ciudad Espina Negra y se ha adentrado a fondo en la guarida del Dragón. Todo parece ir mal para la antigua reliquia, pero la ayuda llega de un viejo amigo.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro

programme.sub-title: The World is Stunned! The Fifth Emperor of the Sea Emerges!
programme.desc: Luffy's recent exploits make their way around the world! The reputation of this mighty pirate begins to grow as all eyes look towards the Straw Hats' next move! Also - German 66 leaves an artifact behind which excites the crew!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: To the Reverie! The Straw Hats' Sworn Allies Come Together!
programme.desc: As the royals make their way to the Reverie, the mighty Navy takes all precautions to make sure they don't fall prey to kidnappings! At the vanguard is Koby, who glimpses Luffy's exploits and remembers their shared past.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sabo Goes into Action! All the Captains of the Revolutionary Army Appear!
programme.desc: A vicious pirate group led by Pinkbeard who describes himself as one of Blackbeard's affiliates attacks a town in the Kingdom of Lulucia while their king and able-bodied soldiers have gone to the Reverie. And four bizarre individuals come to help.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Going into Action! The Implacable New Admiral of the Fleet - Sakazuki!
programme.desc: At New Marineford, Sakazuki, the new Admiral of the Fleet, hears the news about Luffy and recalls the tumultuous Paramount War that haunts the Navy! That game-changing war has repercussions that last into the present!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Paramount War! The Inherited Will of the King of the Pirates!
programme.desc: Nobles from around the world gather for the Reverie as the echoes of the Paramount War resound! Among them are Shirahoshi and her family from the Ryugu Kingdom under the sea. Meanwhile, Admiral Fujitora has a conversation with his new colleague.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: One Step Forward for Her Dream! Shirahoshi Goes Out in the Sun!
programme.desc: Stelly, Sabo's adopted brother and now the king of the Goa Kingdom, walks up to Garp who is escorting the royal family of the Fish-Man Island, with an air of importance and something up his sleeve.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: I Miss Him! Vivi and Rebecca's Sentiments!
programme.desc: Shirahoshi and her family finally reach the Holyland of Mariejois! But all the unexpected attention confuses her. Meanwhile, Vivi from Alabasta meets Leo and Rebecca from Dressrosa, and tells them the story of her journey with the Straw Hats.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: In the Dark Recesses of the Holyland! A Mysterious Giant Straw Hat!
programme.desc: Vivi reunites with Dalton and Dr. Kureha from the Sakura Kingdom and they share their memories of the Straw Hats with Shirahoshi and Rebecca. Meanwhile, a shadowy figure descends a long staircase at the castle in the Holyland and opens a mysterious door.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Holyland in Tumult! The Targeted Princess Shirahoshi!
programme.desc: Shirahoshi crosses the fancy of a Celestial Dragon, and those living gods are not open to having their whims disobeyed! As she is dragged away, King Neptune comes to her rescue, risking life and limb by defying the Celestial Dragon.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: An Explosive Situation! Two Emperors of the Sea Going After Luffy!
programme.desc: The Emperors of the Sea, Big Mom and Kaido decide to team up against Luffy! Meanwhile, Garp hears about the wild exploits of his grandson, all while a mysterious outsider visits the highest authority in the world!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sabo Enraged! The Tragedy of the Revolutionary Army Officer Kuma!
programme.desc: After sneaking into the Land of the Gods, Sabo sees the shocking figure of his friend – Kuma! Abused by the World Government as a pawn in their games, Kuma, who was made an example of what happens when you disobey the gods!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Finally, It Starts! The Conspiracy-filled Reverie!
programme.desc: The Reverie has begun! The representative kings and queens first discuss what to do with Straw Hat Luffy. Meanwhile the Revolutionary Army confirms its desire to save Kuma! All while they recount how the Straw Hats have grown!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Marco! The Keeper of Whitebeard's Last Memento!
programme.desc: In order to recruit a strong ally towards bringing down Kaido, Cat Viper and his crew stop by Whitebeard's homeland to see Marco, the 1st division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Climbing Up a Waterfall! A Great Journey Through the Land of Wano's Sea Zone!
programme.desc: Luffy and the others become excited as they see familiar faces in a newspaper article about the Reverie while they close in on the Land of Wano. But this dangerous and foreboding land is as inaccessible as it is mysterious! The sea itself is a barrier!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Land of Wano! To the Samurai Country where Cherry Blossoms Flutter!
programme.desc: A mysterious country, a rampaging slasher, ancient samurai rituals of seppuku - and Zoro in the crosshairs! When a street assault occurs, all signs point to Zoro! Meanwhile, Luffy finally arrives at the Land of Wano.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Otama Appears! Luffy vs. Kaido's Army!
programme.desc: Stranded alone on the beach, Luffy tries to gather his bearings only to be confronted by some mysterious, and dangerous, local fauna! And then, he meets a little girl named Otama! Meanwhile, Zoro makes trouble for the others who are trying to blend in!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: He'll Come! The Legend of Ace in the Land of Wano!
programme.desc: Otama's gratitude towards Luffy knows no bounds! But the feast she cooks him exhausts her food stores completely! As she suffers from poor drinking water, her companion tells the story of the mysterious outsider she waits for - Ace!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Side Story! The World's Greatest Bounty Hunter, Cidre!
programme.desc: Ambushed and outgunned by a skilled bounty hunter Cidre's group, the Straw Hats rely on the Sunny's Coup de Burst to escape! But they end up stranded without cola! A nearby soda island offers a solution.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Side Story! Clash! Luffy vs. the King of Carbonation!
programme.desc: Luffy and Boa Hancock square off against the Cidre Guild! These unscrupulous bounty hunters have one thing in mind - profit at any cost! When the battle looks won, Cidre gears up in a menacing power suit!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Save Otama! Straw Hat, Bounding through the Wasteland!
programme.desc: Otama recounts her promise to Ace while Luffy rushes her to medical attention. But just as they reach the wasteland, a familiar face comes into view! But Kaido's underlings show up too!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Headliner! Hawkins the Magician Appears!
programme.desc: Otama's temperature is going up and Luffy has no time to waste! However, Hawkins, one of Kaido's Headliners, blocks their way by showing his unique powers and skills which can harm his own men.

programme.desc: Luffy and Zoro have been stalled by Hawkins but their fortune looks bright as they are guided by a woman who Zoro had saved. She leads them to a teahouse and to an herbal remedy for the river poison.

programme.desc: Otama's life is saved by Otsuru at her teahouse. The proud Otama finds it hard to take more kindness. The group learns of the Okobore Town - living on the cast-offs of the officials! Then, suddenly, they were attacked by the Shogun's men!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.desc: Otama has been kidnapped by the Gifters! She is taken to a flourishing town called Bakura Town where a creepy-looking Headliner was expecting her. Luffy and Zoro rush to rescue her along with a samurai, Okiku!

programme.desc: As Luffy, Zoro, and Okiku bounce through Bakura Town on Komachiyo's back, a sumo wrestler comes flying towards them! Interested, they go down to watch sumo but the undefeated yokozuna Urashima has been expecting Okiku there.

programme.desc: Luffy challenges Urashima, the strongest yokozuna in the Land of Wano, to a sumo match! Urashima even uses illegal moves to beat Luffy at any cost! Meanwhile, Holdem tells Otama that he knows she committed a crime and he has to punish her for it.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After Bandit Keith's Machine deck forces Joey to take the defensive, Joey mimics Keith's battle strategy to metalize his Red-Eyes Black Dragon! Is victory assured, or does the cheater Bandit Keith literally have one last card up his sleeve?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 1
programme.desc: Joey challenges Yugi for the right to face Pegasus. In a battle between friends, a fierce match ensues between the two people who know each other's strategies and cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi is shocked as Joey uses the Time Wizard card on him. It's the very same card Yugi gave Joey as a sign of friendship!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi prepares for the ultimate battle against Pegasus with the souls of Grandpa, Kaiba, and Mokuba on the line.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 2
programme.desc: Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi's monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi's soul into a card, just like Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi has found a counter to Pegasus's mind-reading ability: Yugi switches back and forth between his two souls! Yugi is able to destroy Pegasus's Toon World, but the duel has just only begun. The next level of the deadly Shadow Game is about to start!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 4
programme.desc: Yugi crumples under the power of the Shadow Game. His friends yell desperate encouragement, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness. Yugi's chance at victory is slipping away, as is his life!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 5
programme.desc: Pegasus summons Relinquished, a fearsome monster that can consume Yugi's Duel Monsters! Yugi counters with… Kuriboh?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi meets a mysterious Egyptian named Shadi who enters Yugi's mind with the Millennium Key. What are these Millennium Items, and do they hold the answer to the mystery behind the Shadow Games?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends return from the Duelist Kingdom only to meet a young girl named Rebecca who demands that Grandpa return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to her.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca mistakenly believes that Grandpa stole the Blue-Eyes White Dragon from her grandfather. Yugi must defend the Blue-Eyes White Dragon to teach her that it's not the power of the cards, but the heart that's in them that counts.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The two-faced Board of Directors of Kaiba Corporation trap Kaiba inside a virtual reality game. Mokuba recruits Yugi and Joey to free Kaiba from this ultimate game where losing equals death!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The quest for Kaiba continues with a little help from… Mai? But can YUGI and friends adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends rescue Kaiba, but they are still stuck in the game! The only exit is past a Five-Headed Dragon, but in the difficult duel, Joey, Mokuba, and Mailose all their life points!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Duke Devlin defeats Joey and humiliates him in public, forcing Yugi to challenge Duke to a duel. However, this will not be a Duel Monsters duel, but a new game named Dungeon Dice Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: In exchange for Joey's freedom, Yugi agrees to give up Duel Monsters forever if he loses. Unfamiliar with the rules, Yugi gets off to a rough start.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi uses his innate gaming skills to turn the tables on Duke, but Duke has one more rule to mention: All creatures take up territory on the grid-like board. With no room to summon any new monsters, Yugi's position is helpless!

programme.desc: The mysterious menace controlling Bandit Keith shatters the Millennium Puzzle into pieces before setting the dueling arena ablaze. Can Yugi put the Millennium Puzzle back together and save the spirit before the entire room is engulfed in flames?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
